summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology with hands-on research experience designing experiments, evaluating models, and writing up results at Bhabha Atomic Research Centre and Teesside University. Comfortable building data acquisition tooling in Python and C/C++, running structured experiments end to end, and reporting quantitative findings across robotics perception and ML research.

experience.title: Research Fellow
bullets: Designed and ran a research pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset, building medical imaging augmentation and batch-loading memory management for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.
Trained and evaluated U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones on Dice Score and IoU; reported accuracy-latency trade-offs in a written technical evaluation.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Designed and executed a metal surface inspection research protocol combining custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation for microscopic crack analysis.

Built a custom image-stitching and wavelet-denoising pipeline, raising evaluation PSNR from 65 (homography baseline) to 86 through a custom wavelet bank (alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5); deployed ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation for crack-depth profiling, validating results to within ±8% error.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset, building preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% through iterative preprocessing and model tuning, documenting each evaluation cycle.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Ran a structured reliability study on a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system, achieving 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Diagnosed and resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) through systematic root-cause testing.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and hand-computed forward kinematic chains for a 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt/RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.
Planned collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on a physical UR5e; measured AL5B repeatability at <2mm over 10 trials.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Built a YOLOv8-based detection and tracking pipeline on NVIDIA Jetson, sending real-time control commands to an STM32 over UART.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and FreeRTOS task coordination via mutexes.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Designed a quantitative evaluation protocol comparing 8-bit quantized and full-precision models across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC benchmarks.
Measured <1% accuracy degradation with a 0.09 perplexity increase against a ~55% GPU memory footprint reduction.
